### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Limit diagnostic connections, causal links, and contributing factors to those explicitly stated or directly implied by the provider in the transcript. Do not infer relationships or etiologies based on general medical knowledge if the provider does not articulate them.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A/P-Section]: Strictly limit all diagnostic connections, causal links, and contributing factors to those *explicitly articulated by the provider*. Do not infer relationships between patient-reported symptoms and provider-stated diagnoses if the provider does not verbally establish that connection.
